title: D2P Fit Profile
description: Artifact content (artifactType 'd2p:fit-profile'): fit intent, ease rules between precisely paired body and garment definitions, prioritised fit targets and inline material assumptions. 'Target = body reference + ease' is applied only where the paired definitions have the same path type; a girth and a flat width are never implicitly equated (D2P-SEM-071). Negative ease is never accepted silently without a stretch condition (D2P-SEM-073). Seam allowance and shrinkage are not ease.
$comment: Schema catalog section 3.3 (design decision ADR-011 sections 2, 3 and 6). Schema-enforced (catalog section 1.12): fitTarget min/max presence by comparison. Not schema-enforced: sizeSystemRef required when any scope.sizeKeys is used (D2P-REF-009); amount units match the definitions' dimension (D2P-SEM-070); unique ids (D2P-REF-005). Not part of 1.0: ease amounts given as expressions, references to material artifacts (materialAssumptions is the inline substitute).

schemaVersion.description: Full SemVer of the standard release this document was written against.

artifactId.description: ID of the artifact this content belongs to.

revisionId.description: ID of the immutable artifact revision this content is.

name.description: Human-readable name of the fit profile.

intent.description: Fit intent. Extensible vocabulary: 'd2p:fitted', 'd2p:regular', 'd2p:relaxed', 'd2p:oversized', or an extension name.

definitionRegistries.description: Pinned measurement-definition registries (id and version) against which the definitionIds of this document resolve.

easeRules.description: Ease rules of the profile (may be empty, then written as []).

fitTargets.description: Prioritised fit goals on garment measurements. Omitted when there are none.

materialAssumptions.description: Inline material assumptions the profile is designed for. Absent when the profile makes none.

sizeSystemRef.description: Pinned size-system revision against which scope.sizeKeys resolve. Required (referentially, D2P-REF-009) when any rule or target scope uses sizeKeys.

contentDigest.description: Optional digest of this document per digest profile d2p-digest-v1 (excluding contentDigest itself).

easeRule.title: Ease rule
easeRule.description: Ease between one body definition and one garment definition (element type 'd2p:ease-rule'): garment value = body value + amount, where both definitions have the same path type (D2P-SEM-071).

id.description: Stable element ID of the rule, unique within the document.

bodyDefinitionId.description: Body measurement definition (kind 'body', D2P-SEM-075) the ease is added to.

garmentDefinitionId.description: Garment measurement definition (kind 'garment', D2P-SEM-075) the ease results in. Its path type must equal the body definition's (D2P-SEM-071).

easeType.description: 'wearing' (comfort and movement), 'design' (silhouette), 'functional' (a specific function, e.g. layering).

amount.description: Ease amount as a quantity; its unit must match the definitions' dimension (D2P-SEM-070). A negative amount needs a materialCondition with minStretchRatio > 0 (D2P-SEM-073, warning).

priority.description: Priority of the rule; 0 is the highest priority.

scope.description: Sizes and zones the rule applies to. Absent means all sizes and zones.

materialCondition.description: Material condition under which the rule applies. Absent means the rule applies regardless of material.

easeScope.title: Ease scope
easeScope.description: Restriction of a rule or target to sizes and/or body zones. At least one member is present; a present member restricts, an absent member does not.

sizeKeys.description: Sizes the rule or target applies to, resolved against the document's sizeSystemRef (D2P-REF-009).

zones.description: Body zones the rule or target applies to (bodyZone vocabulary).

materialCondition.title: Material condition
materialCondition.description: Material classes (and optional minimum stretch) required for a rule to apply.

materialClasses.description: Material classes for which the rule applies.

minStretchRatio.description: Minimum declared stretch ratio (dimensionless, e.g. 0.2 = 20 % elongation) the material must have. Absent means no stretch requirement.

materialAssumptions.title: Material assumptions
materialAssumptions.description: Inline, declared (not tested) material properties assumed for an evaluation or a fit profile. Reused by evaluation requests.

stretch.description: Declared stretch ratios. Absent means no stretch is declared.

description.description: Free-text description of the assumed material.

materialStretch.title: Material stretch
materialStretch.description: Declared stretch ratios (dimensionless elongation, e.g. 0.3 = 30 %) along the two fabric directions. Declared, not tested.

lengthwise.description: Stretch ratio along the grain (warp or wale direction).

crosswise.description: Stretch ratio across the grain (weft or course direction).

fitTarget.title: Fit target
fitTarget.description: A prioritised fit goal on one garment measurement (element type 'd2p:fit-target'). 'min' requires min and forbids max, 'max' requires max and forbids min, 'range' requires both (schema-enforced).

id.description: Stable element ID of the fit target, unique within the document.

garmentDefinitionId.description: Garment measurement definition the goal constrains.

comparison.description: Kind of goal: 'min' (value ≥ min), 'max' (value ≤ max), 'range' (min ≤ value ≤ max).

min.description: Lower bound; unit must match the definition's dimension (D2P-SEM-070). Present exactly for comparison 'min' and 'range'.

max.description: Upper bound; unit must match the definition's dimension (D2P-SEM-070). Present exactly for comparison 'max' and 'range'.

priority.description: Priority of the goal; 0 is the highest priority.

scope.description: Sizes and zones the goal applies to. Absent means all sizes and zones.

bodyZone.title: Body zone
bodyZone.description: Extensible vocabulary of body zones: 'd2p:chest', 'd2p:waist', 'd2p:hip', 'd2p:shoulder', 'd2p:upper-arm', or extension names. Used by ease scopes and, in module 3d, by avatar profiles and fit maps.
